policy.technical_innovation_definition: A novelty claim requires an independently supported prior-art comparison; a theorem-backed framework can be registered without certifying originality.
policy.engineering_exclusion: Caching, parallelism, memory planning, backend selection, API design, compatibility reproduction, documentation, visualization, and release tooling are not technical innovations by themselves.
policy.priority_status: Registration records mathematical contributions and supporting artifacts, not proven novelty or publication priority.

innovations.title: Exact structural rank and absorbed degrees of freedom for arbitrary multiway categorical fixed effects
innovations.novelty_scope: A general exact computational framework for characteristic-zero structural rank/absorbed DoF with arbitrary finite categorical FE partitions, including exact structural reductions, certified modular rank and exact fallback. The rank identity itself is not claimed as novel.
innovations.prior_art_boundary: Connectivity formulas for two-way FE and conservative/pairwise rules for higher-way FE are established. The registered contribution is the package's exact arbitrary-G computational/certification framework, not the idea that FE DoF is a matrix-rank problem. Correctness review does not establish historical priority; see the 0.6.1 mathematical review.

innovations.title: Exact residual-core reduction for arbitrary multiway categorical HDFE projection
innovations.novelty_scope: An exact arbitrary-G hypergraph leaf-elimination theorem for weighted HDFE projection: recursively degree-one FE vertices force the residual on their unique observation to zero, so only the residual core must be solved and peeled rows can be reconstructed with exact zero residuals.
innovations.prior_art_boundary: Degree-one pruning is known in two-way graph-based HDFE solvers and is not claimed as new. The registered contribution is the arbitrary-G categorical-hypergraph projection theorem, exact recursive reconstruction, and its topology/weight validity conditions. Correctness review does not establish historical priority; see the 0.6.1 mathematical review.

innovations.title: Exact partition-refinement canonicalization and structural design reduction for HDFE models
innovations.novelty_scope: An HDFE-specific exact compilation framework that certifies partition refinement/functional dependencies, canonicalizes redundant FE partitions, constructs a transitive dependency DAG, and removes provably redundant factor or factor-slope columns before dense materialization while preserving the combined design column space.
innovations.prior_art_boundary: Functional dependencies, partition refinement and dummy-variable collinearity are established concepts and are not claimed as new. The registered contribution is their exact HDFE design-space composition, recertification rules, interaction dependency closure and pre-materialization basis-reduction theorem. Correctness review does not establish historical priority; see the 0.6.1 mathematical review.
